content.short: Dragonfly is a global crypto venture capital firm.
content.description: Dragonfly is a crypto-native venture capital firm with more than ten years of investing and building experience. Founded in 2018, it supports crypto teams that aim to reach a global audience by identifying opportunities for innovation and adoption wherever they arise. Dragonfly backs blockchain teams and communities tackling meaningful problems and pushing the industry's boundaries. To date, it has backed teams building generational companies and products in crypto across sectors and stages, from protocols to exchanges, apps, and beyond.
